name: Forgotten Riches
text: Both gangs creep into a sunken sector to strip it of loot that was left behind. Five crates are placed one at a time, the first in the middle tile and each in a tile of its own. Each side then picks an outer tile without a crate and sets up along its outer edge. Cracking crates and hauling them home is the point: the gang with the most crates on its own deployment tile when the fight ends wins. Wandering alone in the dark is dangerous, because a fighter far from every other fighter may be caught out by whatever lives there.
